questions.question:

questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"ecstasy"** means a state of overwhelming happiness or joyful excitement. (परमानंद)

 
 
• **Example: **She was in a state of ecstasy after receiving the good news.
 
 
 
• **"Depression"** refers to a state of severe despondency and dejection, typically felt over a long period and accompanied by feelings of hopelessness and inadequacy. (अवसाद)
 
 
• **Example: **He fell into a deep depression after losing his job.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'ecstasy'** is **'depression'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Delight **(आनंद): A feeling of great pleasure and satisfaction.

 
 
• **Example:** The children screamed with delight when they saw the circus.
 
 
 
• **Disappointment **(निराशा): A feeling of dissatisfaction that follows the failure of expectations or hopes.
 
 
• **Example: **She felt a deep sense of disappointment after the project was canceled.
 
 
 
• **Passion** (जुनून): A strong and barely controllable emotion.
 
 
• **Example:** His passion for music was evident in his performances.
